title: P4097R corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: P4097R corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: P4097R corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Luzon. 102 to 106 days to harvest, 8 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: P4097R corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2018 as NSIC 2018 GMCn 47. Pioneer Hi Bred bred it. It takes 102 to 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 8 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 102 to 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 8 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

P4097R corn takes 102 to 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 8 t/ha matches the average of its group, 8.13. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.text: It was weak against corn earworm, so scout for it from the early weeks. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ears grew about 15.3 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 80.08 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears. Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
Where and when to plant P4097R corn

It is recommended for Luzon. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 102 to 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 8 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of P4097R?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
